faqs.a:
The city recognizes that low-income residents may face challenges associated with
               the rising cost of living and taxes. In furtherance of this recognition, the city
               wishes to provide financial assistance to qualifying, low-income residents in the
               form of a rebate program. The city council intends for this rebate program to promote
               resident welfare by easing the hardship caused by the increasing cost of living and
               city sales tax. The city council finds that this rebate program, as set forth in this
               article, is necessary and directly related to the public's health, safety, and welfare.
(
Ord. No. 4887
, § 1, 1-27-2025)
